name: ACL Anthology 2025.acl-long.595 - SAM Decoding: Speculative Decoding via Suffix Automaton
notes: Primary ACL Anthology landing page. The anthology ID encodes the venue and track: acl-long = ACL 2025 MAIN conference long paper, so venue=acl and venue_track=main are both structural from the ID, not inferred. Author list on the page (Yuxuan Hu, Ke Wang, Xiaokang Zhang, Fanjin Zhang, Cuiping Li, Hong Chen, Jing Zhang) matches the arXiv API author list for 2411.10666 exactly, which is the author-overlap corroboration that rules out a same-title collision. Corroborated independently by the OpenReview DBLP mirror note venueid dblp.org/conf/ACL/2025.
